exposure: risk level (total deliveries, low risk cesarean sections, low risk cesarean sections without previous cesarean delivery)
cohort: 62,685 deliveries in a network of 42 Quirónsalud Hospitals in Spain
finding: The overall rate of CS in the Quirónsalud group (private sector) is slightly higher than that of the Public Healthcare sector in Spain, potentially due to older maternal age and hospital resources.
